department: School of Engineering — Department of Electronic and Computer Engineering

deadline.value: Fall 2027-28 non-local full-time deadline is June 1, 2027 (rolling admissions; local full-time deadline July 15, 2027; HKPFS deadline December 1, 2026).
deadline.quote: For 2027/28 Fall Term Intake (commencing in Sep 2027): | Non-local Applicants* | Full-time: 1 Jun 2027 | Local Applicants | Full-time: 15 Jul 2027 | Admissions is on rolling basis.

gre_subject.value: No ETS GRE Subject Test exists for electrical and computer engineering (ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology).
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: ECE PhD regulations specify that admitted students identify a permanent thesis supervisor no later than the end of their first semester after admission.
supervisor.quote: Each student should identify a permanent academic advisor (thesis supervisor) not later than the first semester after he/she is admitted into the program.

funding.value: Full-time PhD students are eligible for HKUST Postgraduate Studentships (HK$229,620/yr, ~US$29,420/yr for up to 4 years), RedBird PhD Award, and HKPFS.
funding.quote: Postgraduate Studentship (PGS) | HK$229,620 per year (~US$29,420/ year) | Up to 4 years for full-time PhD students

entry_route.value: Admits bachelor's holders with outstanding performance (4-year full-time PhD) and research master's holders (3-year full-time PhD).
entry_route.quote: Full-time: 3 years (with a relevant research master’s degree), 4 years (without a relevant research master’s degree) | Applicants seeking admissions to a doctoral degree program should have obtained a bachelor’s degree with a proven record of outstanding performance from a recognized institution

notes: Research foci include Biomedical Engineering, Control & Robotics, Data Science & AI, ICs & Systems, Microelectronics, Photonics, Quantum Engineering, and Wireless Communications; optional Energy Technology, Nanotechnology, and Scientific Computation concentrations. Also operates a PhD Early Admissions Scheme (Feb-Mar nominations for partner mainland universities).
